android.desc:
Keep your family organized with DatCal, a simple family calendar and planner for managing schedules, events, important dates and reminders in one place.

Whether you are coordinating kids' activities, school events, appointments, birthdays, work schedules or family plans, DatCal helps you keep track of what is coming up.

### A simple family calendar

Family schedules can get busy quickly. DatCal gives you a dedicated place to organize important family events and upcoming activities.

Use it to keep track of:

• Family events and activities  
• School events and important dates  
• Doctor and other appointments  
• Birthdays and anniversaries  
• Kids' activities and schedules  
• Work and personal commitments  
• Family plans and reminders  
• Recurring events  

### Family planner for busy households

DatCal is designed for everyday family organization. Instead of relying on scattered notes or trying to remember every upcoming event, keep your important dates and plans organized in your calendar.

Plan ahead and quickly see what is coming up.

### Family schedule organizer

Use DatCal as a family schedule organizer for:

• Parents managing busy schedules  
• Kids' school and activity calendars  
• Family appointments  
• Weekend plans  
• Birthdays and celebrations  
• Recurring family activities  
• Household events  

### Stay organized

A family calendar should be easy to understand and quick to use. DatCal focuses on keeping your schedule organized without unnecessary complexity.

Create events, keep track of important dates and use reminders to help you stay prepared for what's next.

### Designed for everyday family life

From school mornings and after-school activities to appointments, birthdays and weekend plans, DatCal can help you organize the things that matter to your household.

Whether you need a family planner, household calendar, shared schedule or simple personal organizer, DatCal gives you one place to manage your family's upcoming plans.

### DatCal features

• Family calendar  
• Family planner  
• Family schedule organizer  
• Event management  
• Important dates  
• Reminders  
• Recurring events  
• Household planning  
• Kids' activities  
• School schedule organization  
• Appointment tracking  
• Birthday and anniversary reminders  

DatCal is built for people who want a straightforward way to organize family schedules and important dates on Android.
